title: Patients appear in both the training and the test set
detail: 940 of 1197 test patients (79%) also have records in training; 1413 of 1719 test records belong to them. Test performance is measured partly on patients the model has already seen.
recommendation: Split by patient (GroupShuffleSplit or GroupKFold) and re-report test metrics.

title: Performance depends on data recorded after the prediction time
detail: Removing every record timed after the prediction time lowered test AUROC from 0.831 to 0.802 (difference 0.029, 95% CI 0.017 to 0.042, bootstrap over 1197 patients). Features use information the model would not have at the time it is used.
recommendation: Filter every feature source to times at or before the prediction time; add a test with post-time records.

title: The inference path gives different scores from the validated pipeline
detail: Scoring the 1719 test records through the documented inference command changed 649 scores (largest difference 0.201). AUROC on these records: 0.831 validated vs 0.828 served. The validated performance does not describe what is served.
recommendation: Use one preprocessing and feature path for training and inference, and add a test that compares them.

title: Bad input scored silently: temperature sent in Fahrenheit
detail: The inference command exited normally and returned 1719 scored records with no error or warning; 1480 score(s) changed compared with the valid input.
recommendation: Validate schema, types, units and ranges at the inference boundary; reject or flag the record.

title: Reported metrics cannot be reproduced from the saved test predictions
detail: auroc: reported 0.8771, recomputed 0.8314; auprc: reported 0.6798, recomputed 0.5963; brier: reported 0.1501, recomputed 0.1610; n: reported 6876.0000, recomputed 1719.0000.
recommendation: Compute every reported metric from the saved test predictions in one function, and test it.

title: Reported sensitivity does not match the emitted alerts
detail: Reported 0.9497; recomputed from the alert column 0.9030.
recommendation: Derive operating-point metrics from the same alert column that is served.

title: Reported specificity does not match the emitted alerts
detail: Reported 0.5424; recomputed from the alert column 0.5177.
recommendation: Derive operating-point metrics from the same alert column that is served.

title: Broad exception handler continues silently
detail: Line 59 catches Exception and does not re-raise. Errors become default values or skipped steps instead of visible failures.
recommendation: Catch the specific exception, log it, and fail or flag the record.

title: Two runs of the data step produce different data
detail: The contents of `data/` differ between two clean runs of the same command.
recommendation: Seed every random draw and fix any ordering in the data step.

title: Rerunning the pipeline gives different results
detail: Files that differ between two runs of the same commands on the same inputs: outputs/features.csv, outputs/predictions_test.csv, outputs/metrics.json. 1719 of 1719 common test scores changed (largest change 0.2741); reported AUROC 0.8771362024479836 vs 0.877339819769437.
recommendation: Fix seeds and ordering, then show two identical runs before any clinical evaluation.

title: `RandomForestClassifier` has no random_state
detail: Line 37 creates `RandomForestClassifier` without a fixed random_state, so reruns can differ.
recommendation: Pass random_state from the configured seed.

title: `yaml` is imported but not declared
detail: First imported in readmit/config.py line 5 (1 import site(s)); no requirement provides it. A clean install from the declared dependencies fails at run time.
recommendation: Add PyYAML with an exact version.

title: Served alerts do not use the threshold that was evaluated
detail: 411 of 1719 records scored by the inference command have an alert flag that disagrees with score >= 0.35, the threshold in the reported metrics. Patients flagged in use differ from the evaluated operating point.
recommendation: Read the decision threshold from one versioned source in training, evaluation and serving, and test that they agree.

title: Code reads config key `features.lookback_days`, which the config does not define
detail: Line 51 reads `features.lookback_days` with a fallback default, so any configured value is ignored silently. The same section defines `features.prior_admission_lookback_days`, which no code reads: probably a renamed key.
recommendation: Align the key name in code and config, and fail on unknown or missing keys.

title: Invalid values silently become missing
detail: `to_numeric(errors='coerce')` on line 106 turns unreadable values into NaN/NaT without reporting them.
recommendation: Raise or count and report coerced values.

title: File listing order is not fixed
detail: `staging.iterdir` on line 61 is not wrapped in sorted(); order depends on the file system.
recommendation: Wrap directory listings in sorted().

title: Global NumPy random state used without a seed
detail: `np.random.randint` on line 183 draws from the unseeded global generator.
recommendation: Use np.random.default_rng(seed) passed down from the config.

title: `scikit-learn` is not pinned to an exact version
detail: requirements.txt line 4 declares `scikit-learn >=1.3`. A rebuild can install a different version from the one that was validated.
recommendation: Pin exact versions and keep a lock file with hashes.

title: No test imports `readmit.cli`
detail: 35 lines of code in readmit/cli.py have no direct test.
recommendation: Add known-answer tests for the functions whose output reaches a prediction or a report.

title: Tests do not notice changes to the logic in readmit/cli.py
detail: 2 of 2 single-point changes to this file left every test passing, for example line 40 (2 -> 3).
recommendation: Add tests that pin the expected outputs of this module on known cases.

title: Test `test_validate_rejects_out_of_range` is skipped
detail: Decorator `pytest.mark.skip` on line 51 (reason: "range limits pending sign-off from clinical informatics").
recommendation: Run it; a skipped test can hide a real defect.

title: `exclude_incomplete_followup` is tested but never called by the platform
detail: Function on line 45 is used only by the tests. Behaviour the tests check does not happen in the real pipeline.
recommendation: Confirm whether the pipeline should call it; wire it in or remove it and its test.

title: Code reads config key `C`, which the config does not define
detail: Line 46 reads `C` with a fallback default, so any configured value is ignored silently. A code default is used; confirm it is intended.
recommendation: Align the key name in code and config, and fail on unknown or missing keys.

title: Model artefact loaded without an integrity check
detail: `joblib.load` on line 105 loads a pickled object with no hash or version check.
recommendation: Store a hash and the training commit with the model and verify both at load.

title: No lock file with hashes
detail: Transitive dependencies are not fixed, so two installs can differ even with exact top-level pins.
recommendation: Add a lock file (pip-tools with --generate-hashes, uv or poetry).

title: Config key `features` is never read
detail: A setting that no code reads usually means a renamed key or a dead option.
recommendation: Remove it or wire it to the code that should use it.
